command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-11a. Pre-reboot snapshot, then schedule the reboot the owner's acceptance
# test requires:
#
#   disable/remove only the Ollama portion of compose -> restart/reconcile the HERMES stack
#     -> REBOOT HERMES -> prove EXACTLY ONE Ollama comes back: the Windows-owned P40 service,
#        same models, same API contract, loopback-only.
#   If both runtimes appear, or compose recreates the old container -> COMMISSIONING FAILS.
#
# The reboot is deferred 45 seconds so this command can return and its evidence can be written and
# fetched before the machine goes down. A snapshot lost in the reboot it describes is not evidence.
#
# The power cap is the other thing this reboot settles. It reads 150 W right now, but persistence
# mode is N/A on this host so nvidia-smi has nothing holding it: the boot must clear it to the 250 W
# default, and the service's own startup path must put it back. The service log line "P40 before cap"
# on the far side of the reboot is the proof, and it can only be read AFTER the fact.

Write-Output '--- PRE-REBOOT-SNAPSHOT ---'
Write-Output "now_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "boot_utc=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "compose_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Write-Output "start_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Write-Output "service_script_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\ollama-service\hermes-ollama-service.ps1' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"

Write-Output '--- CONTAINERS-BEFORE ---'
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}|{{.Image}}' 2>&1
Write-Output '--- RESTART-POLICIES ---'
foreach ($n in @('open-webui', 'portainer', 'postgres', 'redis', 'williamos-hermes-inference-proxy')) {
    $s = docker inspect $n --format '{{.State.Status}} restart={{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}} project={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' 2>&1
    Write-Output "$n :: $($s -join ' ')"
}
Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-CONTAINER-GONE ---'
Write-Output "any_container_named_ollama=$((docker ps -a --filter name=ollama --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1) -join ',')"
Write-Output "ollama_image_still_present=$(docker images ollama/ollama --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}}' 2>&1)"

Write-Output '--- SERVICE-BEFORE ---'
Write-Output "task_state=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama').State)"
Get-Process -Name 'ollama*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "process pid=$($_.Id) path=$($_.Path)" }
try {
    $t = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 8
    Write-Output "api_models=$($t.models.Count) list=$(($t.models.name | Sort-Object) -join ',')"
} catch { Write-Output "api_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Output '--- GPU-BEFORE-REBOOT ---'
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,persistence_mode,power.limit,power.default_limit,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- MODEL-STORE-BEFORE ---'
$b = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File | Measure-Object -Sum Length
Write-Output "blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum)"
$m = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\manifests' -Recurse -File
Write-Output "manifests=$($m.Count)"
Write-Output '--- SERVICE-LOG-BEFORE ---'
Get-Content 'C:\ProgramData\WilliamOS\logs\hermes-ollama-service.log' -Tail 8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Output '--- SCHEDULING-REBOOT ---'
& shutdown.exe /r /t 45 /c "WilliamOS #997 commissioning acceptance test: prove exactly one Ollama returns" /d p:2:4
Write-Output "shutdown_rc=$LASTEXITCODE"
Write-Output "reboot_requested_at_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
